baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled construction رَتِّلِ ... تَرْتِيلًا governs ٱلْقُرْءَانَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command plus cognate verbal noun intensifies a mode of clear, deliberate, well-composed vocal delivery; the object identifies reading or recitation as the material being delivered.

activation_trace.role: Measured, clear articulation supplies the baseline discipline of delivery.
Reading and reciting identifies the voiced act on which that discipline operates.

changed_reading.after: Render the Qur'an with deliberate clarity, composure, and fully realized articulation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَتِّلِ and ٱلْقُرْءَانَ join ordered alignment to a gathered object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gathered textual or sonic units are placed one after another in a stable arrangement. Tartil therefore concerns relational ordering as well as tempo.

activation_trace.role: Ordered alignment and sequencing supplies the organizing operation.
Gathering supplies the plurality of units that tartil places into relation.

changed_reading.after: Assemble the gathered revelation audibly, giving each unit a distinct and ordered place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: زِدْ is coordinated with the emphatic measured-recitation command.
baseline_models.mechanism: Increase is live, but its neighboring branch of affected excess and the command for measured articulation keep addition from becoming formless maximalism.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supplies the positive expansion commanded by زِدْ.
Overdoing and affectation supplies the nearby failure mode against which measure matters.
Measured articulation functions as the constraint that keeps increase disciplined.

changed_reading.after: Increase the amount only as an increase that remains deliberate, lucid, and free of affected excess.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of زِدْ reaches provision for a journey, while Qur'an and tartil supply course and order.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant provision branch recasts increase as equipping oneself. A patterned, ordered recitation can then be carried as provision through a transition.

activation_trace.role: Carrying provision for transition supplies the exploratory sense of increase as self-equipping.
A manner, pattern, or directed course supplies the route-shaped content being carried.
Ordered sequencing turns the provision into a traversable course rather than an undifferentiated stock.

changed_reading.before: Add more time to the recital.
changed_reading.after: Equip yourself for passage by carrying an ordered verbal provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Standing to the night is repeatedly quantified by little, half, diminution, and increase. Tartil becomes the invariant ordering discipline inside a deliberately adjustable duration, not a demand for sheer accumulation.

activation_trace.role: Rising with resolve supplies the enacted frame in which the amount is calibrated.
Undertaking an affair at night supplies the bounded temporal field of the practice.
Smallness supplies one explicit low setting in the range.
The half supplies a measured midpoint rather than an open-ended quantity.
Removing part of a whole supplies the downward adjustment paired with increase.
Increase supplies the upward adjustment within the same calibrated range.
Ordered sequencing supplies the stable quality preserved across changing quantities.

structural_cues: 73:2-4 forms a chain of alternatives: little, half, diminish, or increase, followed by the emphatic رتل ... ترتيلا construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a quantified night practice and opposing adjustments; I infer that tartil is the quality-control invariant across those settings. A live alternative is that every quantity term governs night duration only and does not directly characterize recital quality.

changed_reading.before: Increase the quantity and recite slowly.
changed_reading.after: Tune the nocturnal portion up or down while preserving an ordered, fully articulated mode of recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A weighty saying is to be received as something cast upon the addressee. Gathering and aligning its units makes tartil a load-handling interface: weight is borne through sequencing rather than reduced or beautified away.

activation_trace.role: Receiving and being taught speech supplies the incoming transfer that must be handled.
An utterance brought out in speech identifies the transferred material as voiced saying.
The burdening of a load supplies the pressure that ordered delivery must carry.
Gathering supplies manageable units within the received weight.
Alignment distributes the heavy saying into a bearable ordered sequence.

structural_cues: 73:5 immediately follows the tartil command and shifts to a saying that will be cast upon the addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receiving, utterance, and burden; I supply the arrow that ordered recitation distributes the burden without lightening its import. Alternatively, 73:5 may explain the revelation's gravity without assigning tartil any load-bearing function.

changed_reading.before: Tartil is a polished style applied to a text.
changed_reading.after: Tartil is the disciplined handling by which a heavy received saying can be borne, retained, and voiced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night practice begins an operation that binds more firmly, makes elements correspond, and straightens utterance. Tartil is activated as synchronization of cadence, bodily footing, and saying, not only slower phonation.

activation_trace.role: The beginning of speech or action supplies night practice as a newly arising operation.
Tight binding supplies the increased firmness produced by that operation.
One thing corresponding to another supplies the synchronization mechanism.
Straightness, balance, and alignment supplies the resulting orientation.
Spoken utterance supplies the output made straighter by the night operation.
Ordered alignment supplies the focus operation capable of coordinating those dimensions.

structural_cues: 73:6 pairs two comparatives around night arising: more forceful in وطئا and straighter in utterance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beginning, binding, correspondence, straightness, and utterance; I infer a coordinated causal chain from night tartil to embodied and verbal alignment. The materially live alternative is that وطئا means pressure or firm footing rather than correspondence.

changed_reading.before: Recite carefully because the night is quiet.
changed_reading.after: Use ordered night recitation to synchronize footing, attention, cadence, and utterance into a firmer alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bounded night ordering is set against daylight's opening and extended room for movement and livelihood. Tartil becomes a compact counter-rhythm that prepares for, and prevents dispersion within, the long daytime flow.

activation_trace.role: Undertaking an affair at night supplies the concentrated side of the temporal contrast.
Day opening in light supplies the expansive counter-period.
Breadth for movement and livelihood supplies the dispersive daytime activity.
Extended time supplies the duration over which that activity spreads.
Compact ordered sequencing supplies the counter-rhythm to daytime extension.

structural_cues: 73:6-7 directly contrast night arising with a long daytime field of movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concentrated night practice and prolonged daytime movement; I infer that ordered recital stabilizes the practitioner across the transition. Alternatively, the contrast may only allocate time and imply no formative carryover.

changed_reading.before: Tartil is an isolated nighttime technique.
changed_reading.after: Tartil establishes a finite night cadence that can hold orientation through the day's extended movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembering is paired with decisive separation. Against the focus image of Qur'an as gathering, tartil can work by cutting a stream into distinct units so those units can be recollected and recomposed.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back to presence supplies the mnemonic result of distinct units.
Cutting and separating supplies the segmentation operation.
Gathering supplies the complementary recomposition of separated units.
Sequential ordering supplies the rule by which separated units are gathered again.

structural_cues: 73:8 pairs two imperatives and repeats a verb with its verbal noun, echoing the focus command's emphatic construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembering, cutting, gathering, and ordering; I infer that separation enables mnemonic gathering. The alternative is that تبتل denotes devotional withdrawal only and contributes no phonetic segmentation.

changed_reading.before: Tartil keeps an already continuous recital orderly.
changed_reading.after: Tartil cuts the flow into memorable units and gathers them back into a coherent sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-restraint surrounds hostile saying and culminates in a separation qualified by beauty. Measured recitation becomes rehearsal for measured public response: clarity without reactive excess, followed by controlled disengagement.

activation_trace.role: Restraining the self from agitation supplies the governing response discipline.
Others' spoken utterance supplies the social pressure against which discipline is tested.
Separation and disconnection supplies the non-retaliatory exit from hostile exchange.
Beauty in action qualifies the manner of disengagement.
Measured, well-composed speech supplies a repeatable form of restraint.

structural_cues: 73:10 places endurance before what they say and explicitly qualifies the ensuing separation as beautiful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restrained endurance, hostile saying, separation, and beauty; I infer that tartil trains a transferable speech ethic. A live alternative is that recitation and social conduct are parallel commands with no training relation.

changed_reading.after: Tartil rehearses a speech ethic capable of meeting hostile words with composure and beautiful disengagement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A solid gathered mass is disturbed, becomes a gathered sand-mound, and then pours loose. The focus's gathering plus ordered alignment becomes a counter-form: speech is deliberately held in sequence while seemingly stable formations disintegrate.

activation_trace.role: Severe disturbance supplies the force that destabilizes established form.
A high, solid aggregation supplies the initial image of stable collected mass.
Material gathered into a mound supplies the intermediate but unstable form.
Poured, cascading material supplies the terminal loss of fixed arrangement.
Gathering supplies the focus's answer to dispersal.
Ordered alignment supplies a maintained form amid the context's collapsing forms.

structural_cues: 73:14 repeats the mountains on both sides of their transformation into a loose sand formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disturbance, solid gathering, sand gathering, and pouring; I infer that tartil is a practiced counter-form to disintegration. Alternatively, the cosmic scene may intensify warning without commenting on recitational order.

changed_reading.before: Tartil arranges words for local clarity.
changed_reading.after: Tartil practices the gathering and preservation of meaningful order in a world whose largest formations can pour apart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Message-bearing is joined to knowledgeable witness and then exposed to rejection. Tartil shifts from private vocal technique to custodial transmission: ordered articulation preserves a message in a form that can stand as testimony and be obeyed or refused.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the transmission relation beyond solitary reading.
Testimony stated from knowledge supplies the accountability function of faithful transmission.
Departure from obedience supplies the possibility that the transmitted message can be refused.
Reading, reciting, and teaching recitation supplies the repeatable transmission act.
Ordered sequencing supplies fidelity of form across transmission.

structural_cues: 73:15 repeats messenger language around a comparison, and 73:16 immediately narrates disobedience to the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies message, witness, and rejection; I infer that tartil preserves the message's transmissible and testimonial form. The alternative is that the messenger comparison concerns authority alone, not recitation fidelity.

changed_reading.after: Tartil keeps a received message ordered enough to be transmitted, witnessed, and answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: A reminder attracts volition, is actively taken, and becomes a traversed way. The Qur'an's pattern branch and tartil's sequence branch turn recital into route construction: ordered units make the reminder navigable.

activation_trace.role: A reminder that causes recollection supplies the content offered for uptake.
The self's attraction toward a thing supplies the voluntary turn toward the reminder.
Taking or acquiring supplies the conversion of inclination into appropriation.
An extended traversable road supplies the resulting spatial model.
A manner, pattern, and directed course supplies route-like potential within Qur'an.
Sequencing supplies the ordered steps that make the course takeable.

structural_cues: 73:19 moves in one sentence from reminder to willing, taking, and a way toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, inclination, taking, and road; I infer that tartil renders the reminder as a navigable sequence. Alternatively, the road may denote a general life choice independent of recitational form.

changed_reading.after: Tartil lays the reminder out as an ordered course that a willing hearer can actually take.

context_deltas.mechanism: The solitary addressee's standing is joined by a gathered group, and recitation later appears as a plural command. Ordered recital becomes a socially transmissible cadence that can coordinate participation without requiring identical capacity.

activation_trace.role: Rising with resolve supplies the shared enacted practice.
A group gathered around something supplies the social body participating with the addressee.
Reading, reciting, and teaching recitation supplies the repeatable practice extended to the plural audience.
A stable sequence supplies a form that can be shared across unequal participants.

structural_cues: 73:20 joins the singular addressee to a group with him and later repeats recitation as a plural imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared standing and plural recitation; I infer that tartil's ordered form enables resilient collective participation. The alternative is that the grammatical widening changes the audience but says nothing about synchronized or shared cadence.

changed_reading.before: Tartil is a solitary practitioner's exact technique.
changed_reading.after: Tartil gives a community a stable recitational form that can survive differences in duration and capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact measure belongs to divine estimation while human enumeration fails; recitation is twice tied to what opens with ease across illness, travel, and fighting. Quantity therefore flexes with capacity, while tartil preserves intelligible order and articulation as the practice's integrity.

activation_trace.role: A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies exact calibration.
Exhaustive counting supplies the human operation declared unsustainable.
Repeated recitation supplies the practice retained after exact enumeration yields.
Opening and ease after difficulty supplies the adaptive threshold for amount.
Weakened capacity and restricted movement supplies one reason fixed quantity cannot govern everyone.
Traveling through the land supplies a second capacity-changing condition.
Mutual combat supplies a third, extreme condition under which the practice persists adaptively.
The risk of overdoing supplies the focus-side limit corrected by adaptive ease.
Clear, deliberate articulation supplies the integrity that need not disappear when amount changes.

structural_cues: 73:20 states inability to enumerate, repeats recite what is easy twice, and places illness, travel, and fighting between the repetitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine measure, failed human enumeration, repeated ease, and varied constraints; I infer a quality invariant under variable quantity. A live alternative is that 73:20 only replaces the earlier duration rule and does not define tartil's continuing quality.

changed_reading.before: The focus presses toward a fixed ideal quantity of prolonged recital.
changed_reading.after: Preserve lucid, ordered recitation at the amount that genuinely opens under present capacity; integrity is exact, quantity is adaptive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel, seeking surplus, advancing a recoverable contribution, sending good ahead, and receiving recompense form an economy of carried and forwarded value. This context strongly activates the focus's non-dominant ز و د mapping: ordered recitation can be provision accumulated for passage and future encounter.

activation_trace.role: Journeying through the land supplies the literal transition for which provision is carried.
Seeking a thing supplies purposeful acquisition during the journey.
Increase and surplus supplies the value sought and echoes the focus's command to add.
Cutting off wealth or work for a returned recompense supplies the forward investment mechanism.
Advancing ahead supplies the temporal direction in which the provision is sent.
Recompense for work supplies the later recovery of forwarded value.
Carried journey-provision supplies the split-root bridge from increase to equipping oneself.
A directed course supplies the route along which the provision matters.
Ordered sequencing gives the carried provision a usable internal arrangement.

structural_cues: 73:20 links travel and seeking surplus to giving, sending good ahead, finding it later, and recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel and a forward-value sequence, while the split focus mapping supplies journey-provision; I infer that recital is one form of carried and advanced value. The alternative is that the economic sequence concerns deeds generally and never feeds back into زِدْ.

changed_reading.before: Increase means extending the present night's quantity.
changed_reading.after: Increase can also mean stocking an ordered provision whose value travels ahead of the reciter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects the anatomical teeth branch of رتل to punitive food imagery; it remains anchored in the focus's oral recitation and explicit well-spaced-teeth branch, reinforced by the context's literal throat obstruction. Render it only as a speculative bodily counter-image, never as the lexical gloss of tartil.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's رتل inventory includes bright, even, well-spaced teeth, and the command directly governs oral recitation.

activation_trace.role: Well-arranged, spaced teeth supplies an anatomical image of differentiated oral passage.
Vocal reading supplies the mouth-and-throat action to which the image attaches.
Tasting and taking food supplies the contrasting oral intake.
A choking obstruction in the throat supplies the anti-image of blocked passage.

changed_reading.before: Tartil beautifies the sound issuing from the mouth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, tartil spaces the oral channel so meaningful sound passes distinctly, the bodily inverse of a throat stopped by choking food.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant cross-domain activation: Qur'an's root inventory and the later mercy root both expose womb images, while birth appears elsewhere in the context. It remains anchored to the focus's own ق ر ء branch and tartil's ordering, but downstream prose must label gestation as an analogy of containment and maturation, not an interpretation of the proper name Qur'an.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's ق ر ء inventory includes a womb enclosing a pregnancy, beside tartil's ordered alignment.

activation_trace.role: A womb gathering and enclosing a pregnancy supplies the containing chamber.
Ordered sequencing supplies gradual internal differentiation within containment.
Birth and the putting down of a pregnancy supplies the eventual emergence from containment.
The female womb supplies a context echo that reactivates the focus's enclosing branch.

changed_reading.before: Recitation releases already formed units in sequence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, ordered recitation holds gathered meaning long enough to differentiate and mature before bringing it forth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates menstrual-cycle and appointed-time branches under the proper name Qur'an. It remains anchored through the focus root and the surah's repeated fractional scheduling, but it should be rendered only as a qualified temporal-pattern analogy, never as a replacement gloss for Qur'an.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's ق ر ء inventory includes both a recurring cycle-period and an appointed time, joined to tartil's sequence.

activation_trace.role: A cycle marked by alternating periods supplies recurrence rather than continuous duration.
An appointed time arriving or being delayed supplies temporal placement.
Order and succession supplies the internal score of each recurring period.
Night as a recurrent temporal domain supplies the repeating container.
The third as a fractional part supplies recurring subdivision of the night.
Measured limit supplies calibration of each cycle.

changed_reading.before: The command prescribes one extended block of recital.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it establishes a recurring, appointed recitational cycle whose measured portion can expand or contract.

strongest_changes: The quantity sequence turns increase into calibration and leaves ordered articulation as the invariant quality.
The heavy saying makes tartil a way of receiving, distributing, and bearing weight through sequence.
Night footing and straight utterance expand tartil into embodied synchronization.
The closing ease rule makes the practice adaptive across illness, travel, and conflict without abandoning intelligible form.
The non-dominant ز و د mapping becomes materially live when travel, surplus, advancing value, and recompense appear together.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several coexisting mechanisms rather than one gloss: articulation, assembly, calibration, load-bearing, social transmission, and provision for passage. The most distinctive activation came from retaining the split ز ي د mapping and allowing later travel and forward-value imagery to strengthen it without displacing the stronger measured-recitation models.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal claim that tartil distributes the weight of 73:5 is stronger than mere adjacency but remains reader-supplied.
73:20 may revise quantity alone rather than explicitly preserving tartil as the quality invariant.
The provision, dental-throat, gestational, and cyclical models are branch-grounded but remain deliberately exploratory and should not be rendered as lexical substitutions.
